title: Dengue deaths top 500 this year in Bangladesh - Outbreak News Today
text:
Dengue deaths top 500 this year in Bangladesh 
 Subscribe Sign in Indian subcontinent Dengue deaths top 500 this year in Bangladesh
 Robert Herriman Nov 17, 2026 Share The nimber of dengue related fatalities surpassed the 500 mark Monday and today brings five more deaths.
 In the past 24 hours, the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports 1,537 additional dengue cases and five deaths, bringing the totals to 165,644 cases and 507 deaths.
 Bangladesh's record dengue fever season in 2023 with Dr. Md Rafiul Hasan 
 Of the newly hospitalised patients, 444 were reported in Dhaka Division, 57 in Mymensingh Division, 297 in Chattogram Division, 267 in Khulna Division, 123 in Rajshahi Division, 38 in Rangpur Division, 308 in Barishal Division and three in Sylhet Division.
 The five new deaths are all from Dhaka.
 As a comparison to recent years:
 In 2025, the country recorded 102,861 dengue cases and 413 deaths between January 1 and December 31.
 In 2024, a total of 101,214 people were infected with dengue, while 575 died of the disease during the year.
 The year 2023 saw 321,179 dengue-related hospitalisations and 1,705 deaths across the country.
